Title: SQL Data Warehouse name change and GUID migration

Body.Content:
Azure SQL Data Warehouse is a fast, flexible, and secure analytics platform for customers of all sizes. Customers can quickly implement a high-performance, globally available, and lower-cost secure cloud data warehouse. Effective November 1, 2018, GUIDs and resource names for the Storage meters for SQL Data Warehouse customers will change. There will be no impacts to pricing.
